title: Assistant Manager – HR Operations & Talent Acquisition
company: Jain University School of Allied Healthcare & Sciences
description:
We are looking for an experienced HR professional to manage HR Operations and Talent Acquisition, ensuring efficient employee lifecycle management, timely recruitment, and continuous improvement of HR processes.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage HR operations, HRMS, attendance, leave, onboarding, and exit formalities.
* Implement HR policies and maintain employee records and documentation.
* Coordinate performance management, appraisals, and employee engagement initiatives.
* Handle end-to-end recruitment, from sourcing and screening to offer release.
* Partner with business heads and hiring managers to fulfil manpower requirements.
* Prepare HR MIS reports and leverage AI tools to improve HR processes and recruitment efficiency.

Requirements

* 3–5 years of experience in HR Operations and Talent Acquisition.
* MBA/PGDM in Human Resources or equivalent qualification.
* Strong knowledge of HRMS, employee lifecycle management, and end-to-end recruitment.
* Experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, job portals, and AI-enabled sourcing tools.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

Pay: ₹480,000.00 - ₹540,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* Current CTC
* Expected CTC
* Notice period
* Are you available for a face-to-face interview in Kochi?

Education:

* Master's (Required)

Language:

* Malayalam (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: HR Recruiter
description:
**Job Description: Recruiter**

**Company:** SLBS Marklance Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** Palarivattom, Kochi  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Working Days:** Monday to Saturday

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a proactive and target-oriented Recruiter to join our HR team. The ideal candidate should have good communication skills, a positive attitude, and the ability to manage end-to-end recruitment activities to meet the company's hiring requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Handle end-to-end recruitment for various positions, especially Business Development Executives (BDEs) and sales-related roles.
* Source candidates through job portals, referrals, social media, databases, and other recruitment channels.
* Screen resumes and conduct initial HR interviews to assess candidate suitability.
* Schedule interviews and coordinate with hiring managers.
* Follow up with candidates throughout the recruitment process to ensure interview attendance and joining.
* Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly recruitment targets.
* Maintain candidate databases and update recruitment trackers regularly.
* Prepare daily recruitment reports covering calls, interviews, selections, and joiners.
* Ensure timely closure of open positions as per business requirements.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
* Freshers and candidates with recruitment experience can apply.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Basic knowledge of MS Excel and recruitment processes.
* Strong follow-up, coordination, and organisational skills.
* Ability to work in a target-driven environment.
* Immediate joiners preferred.

**Salary and Benefits**

* **Fixed Salary per month**
* Opportunity to develop HR and Talent Acquisition skills.
* Career growth opportunities based on performance.

**Work Schedule**

* Monday to Saturday
* Full-time, work-from-office position at Palarivattom, Kochi.

**Interested candidates can share their resumes with the HR team.**

Pay: ₹12,000.00 - ₹15,500.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: HR Recruiter
description:
HR Recruiter

Catalyst Education – Kochi, Kerala

Job Type: Full-time

Salary: ₹10,000 – ₹15,000 per month (Based on experience)

Schedule: Day Shift

About Us

Catalyst Education is a fast-growing educational organization based in Kochi, Kerala. We specialize in student counseling, career pathways, and academic program management. To support our expanding teams, we are looking for a dynamic and organized HR Recruiter to manage our end-to-end recruitment process.

Job Overview

HR Recruiter to join our internal human resources team in Kochi. In this role, you will be responsible for sourcing, screening, interviewing, and onboarding candidates for various roles (such as Academic Counselors, Telecallers, and Sales Executives).

If you have a keen eye for talent, strong interpersonal skills, and want to build a career in Human Resources, we would love to connect with you.

Key Responsibilities

\* Sourcing & Sifting: Source active and passive candidates using job portals (Indeed, LinkedIn), social media, and professional networks.

\* Screening & Shortlisting: Review resumes and conduct initial telephonic/virtual screenings to assess candidate suitability, communication skills, and cultural fit.

\* Interview Coordination: Schedule and coordinate interviews with department heads and senior management.

\* Candidate Management: Maintain regular communication with candidates throughout the hiring pipeline to ensure a smooth candidate experience.

\* Onboarding & Documentation: Assist with onboarding formalities, documentation, and maintenance of employee records.

\* Pipeline Management: Maintain accurate tracking reports and recruitment metrics.

Requirements & Qualifications

\* Education: Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business Administration, Psychology, or any related stream (MBA in HR is a plus).

\* Experience: Freshers with exceptional communication skills or candidates with 0–2 years of experience in HR recruitment, talent acquisition, or HR coordination.

\* Language Proficiency: Fluency in English and Malayalam is required.

\* Skills: Excellent communication, strong organizational skills, and proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel) and email correspondence.

Benefits & Perks

\* Fixed monthly salary between ₹10,000 – ₹15,000.

\* Supportive, growth-oriented work environment.

\* Professional development and hands-on experience in corporate HR management.

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹15,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
